result.title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
result.summary: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DCKV，一个面向混合语言模型 prompt KV cache 的可微变换编码器：变换、量化器与以 prompt token 及已解码邻位为条件的熵模型，针对冻结基座模型的码长和输出变化联合端到端训练；在 Qwen3.5-2B 上以不超过 1.8 个点的性能损失实现 55 倍以上压缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「冻结 LM 输出变化」构造率失真目标、按下游影响分配码率的做法，可供核查 latent 状态压缩后视觉或推理信息是否仍被使用、以及如何度量信息坍缩；但该工作本身是纯文本 KV 缓存的存储效率问题，与 LVR 的状态生成机制无直接联系。
